name: io.github.titouannnn/stackcheck-mcp
title: stackcheck
description: Latest stable npm/PyPI/Maven versions plus the incompatibilities between them.

environmentVariables.name: STACKCHECK_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Cache directory (default: the platform cache dir)

environmentVariables.name: STACKCHECK_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Cache TTL in seconds (default 21600, 0 disables the cache)

environmentVariables.name: STACKCHECK_CACHE_MAX_AGE
environmentVariables.description: Days before an unused cache entry is deleted (default 60, 0 never prunes)
